issues: Benign React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — carry-over from dev-time visual-editor instrumentation; no functional impact (same as iteration 149).

critical_code_review_comments: CRAGovernance.jsx has grown further with AIAnalyst + PromptDialog + 3 new dialog states — 758+ lines already. Consider splitting per-tab components into individual files (mission/products/ledger/vuln/declaration) to keep <500 LOC.

cra_governance.py: /insight caches per-org for 120s keyed on counts — good — but the LLM fallback uses `_CRA_INSIGHT_CACHE` (unbounded dict). Add a simple LRU cap to avoid slow memory growth on multi-tenant.

cra_governance.py verification-link uses issue_portal_token with role='auditor'; public_verify correctly 403s non-auditor tokens. Consider rate-limiting POST /products/{ref}/verification-link (auditor tokens are 30-day so cheap to mint many).
Frontend PromptDialog: ensure textarea/inputs autofocus and Enter-submits for keyboard flow; also disable submit while pending API call to avoid double-submits.
cra-verify-link is displayed on-page — good — but should be a copyable <code> or have a 'Copy link' button (small UX polish).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (title, insight, seed/clear, approve dialog, verify link, public verify page, vuln dialog, declaration dialog)

seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/cra/demo/seed twice through both backend tests and the UI; 5 sample products (Aegis Identity Broker, Sentinel Web Firewall, HomeGuard Smart Lock, VaultCore Secure Element, NoteFlow Productivity Suite) exist along with 1 assessment + 1 SBOM. Also cleared+re-seeded to validate DELETE. Total 7 products on org after run. Approved classification for CRA-PROD-00012 via UI. Declaration approve flow opened and cancelled without persisting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 approved changes are live and verified end-to-end. Notes: (1) after login the URL goes to /app (no trailing slash) — use wait_for_response on POST /api/auth/login instead of wait_for_url('**/app/**'). (2) An onboarding tour modal appears on first dashboard load — dismiss via `button:has-text("Skip")`. (3) The public verify URL is safest to build from the API path (POST /api/cra/products/{ref}/verification-link returns {path}); don't regex it out of the on-page cra-verify-link text or it collides with the 'Expires:' label. (4) Product select in Ledger and Declaration tabs is a native <select> — use select_option. (5) The declaration approve button only renders + enables AFTER 'Evaluate Market Readiness' has been clicked with a product selected.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. The only anomaly was a self-inflicted test bug where a greedy regex captured the 'Expires' label after the token when scraping the on-screen link — fixed by using the backend-returned path. All approved changes work as specified.
